title: Inter-Swarm Communication Protocol (ISCP)
purpose: Controls how Careers swarm, KHELOS swarm, and Anchor layer communicate without chaos — avoiding agent noise, circular loops, and fake escalation.

system_stack.note: The KPGS system stack is now 4 tiers deep. Each tier has a strict role boundary.

tiers.name: Apex
tiers.function: High-level decisions, swarm coordination, strategic direction

tiers.name: KHELOS
tiers.function: Signal integrity, POC validation, auto-blocks FOC before Apex sees it

tiers.name: Anchor
tiers.function: Smoke intercept, personnel protection, 4Ws gating, external noise filter

tiers.name: Swarms
tiers.function: Internal SWFUS lifecycle execution within department boundaries

signal_control_law.note: No agent is allowed to violate these 5 laws. KHELOS enforces via FIREWALL MODE.

laws.reason: Sensing is intake only — no side effects
Witnessing is observation only — no judgment
Framing is structure only — no interpretation
Understanding processes existing data — no fabrication
Streaming is output only — no transformation

signal_control_law.enforcement: KHELOS FIREWALL MODE auto-blocks any agent violating SCL-01 through SCL-05
signal_control_law.result: Total separation of responsibilities = no contamination = pure POC pipeline

routing_matrix.note: Three routing cases govern every signal through KHELOS.

cases.name: CLEAN_SIGNAL
cases.condition: Signal passes all SWFUS phases without FOC detection
cases.path: Sense → Witness → Frame → Understand ✅ POC → Stream → Apex/MMAO

cases.name: FOC_DETECTED
cases.condition: Witness or Understand detects FOC noise pattern
cases.path: Sense → Witness → Frame → Understand ❌ FOC → LOOPBACK → Frame

cases.name: UNKNOWN_INCOMPLETE
cases.condition: Signal is ambiguous — neither clear POC nor clear FOC
cases.path: Sense → Witness → Frame → Understand ⚠️ IIDP HOLD → TBFP monitor
cases.escalation: After 300s, escalate to Apex for human review

iscp_protocol.note: The 3-level request-validate-route protocol for inter-swarm communication.

level_1_request.name: REQUEST
level_1_request.description: Agent submits communication request with SWFUS state, intent, and target

schema.swfus_state: Current SWFUS phase of requesting agent (sense/witness/frame/understand/stream)
schema.intent: What the agent wants to communicate (data_share/escalation/status_query/resource_request)

level_2_validation.name: VALIDATION
level_2_validation.description: KHELOS checks the request for POC validity and permission

checks.description: Is this request POC-valid? Does it serve the orchard?
Is the requesting agent authorized to communicate with the target?
Does the payload stay within department boundaries?
Does the payload contain any FOC noise patterns?
Is the requesting agent within its communication rate limit?

level_2_validation.firewall_mode: If any check fails, request is auto-blocked BEFORE Apex sees it

level_3_routing.name: ROUTING
level_3_routing.description: After validation, the request is routed to the appropriate tier

routes.action: Route to target swarm for internal execution
Escalate to Apex for high-level decision
Block and log to IIDP decline register
Buffer in TBFP monitor queue for 300s
Redirect to correct department based on SWFUS classification

apex_khelos_contract.note: The communication contract between Apex (Orchestrator) and KHELOS (Validator).
apex_khelos_contract.axiom: KHELOS does not compete with Apex — KHELOS protects Apex. KHELOS does not build the orchard — KHELOS ensures the orchard stays true.

anchor_khelos_contract.note: Anchor handles external perimeter. KHELOS handles internal signal integrity. No overlap.

swarm_swarm_contract.note: How execution swarms (Careers, future departments) communicate through ISCP.
rules: All inter-swarm communication MUST route through KHELOS validation
No direct swarm-to-swarm data transfer without ISCP Level 2 approval
Each department operates within its own SWFUS lifecycle — no cross-contamination
Shared telemetry is read-only — no department can mutate another department's state
Rate limit: 100 ISCP requests per department per tick cycle
